steps.eval: window.__set=(sel,val)=>{const el=document.querySelector(sel);Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el,val);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}; (async()=>{const tok=localStorage.getItem('token'); const r=await fetch('/api/admin/accounts',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+tok},body:JSON.stringify({name:'Content Editor',email:'editor'+Date.now()+'@test.local',role:'admin',generatePassword:true,permissions:['content','contact']})}); const j=await r.json(); window.__tp=j.temporaryPassword; localStorage.setItem("__tp", j.temporaryPassword); window.__email=j.data.email; const l=await fetch('/api/auth/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email:j.data.email,password:j.temporaryPassword})}); const lj=await l.json(); localStorage.setItem('token',lj.token); localStorage.setItem('user',JSON.stringify(lj.user)); return 'created '+j.data.email+' '+JSON.stringify(lj.user.permissions)+' must='+lj.user.mustChangePassword;})()
